text:
anya: Starting int4 onboarding for Helios14B (mixed Llama-style qkv with Mistral head packing). Short prompts look fine but long-document summarize tests show token echoing after ~2k tokens.

ram: can you paste the failing prompt + the exact packer we used? which qpack version?

anya: packer: qpack v1 (from package step), export script used: tools/export_hf.py --format=redwood --layout=hybrid. repro command: `./bench_infer --model=helios14b --quant=int4 --seq_len=8192 --prompt tests/8k_summary.txt --use-kvcache`

tess: two suspects: 1) head-order mismatch between packer and runtime, 2) rotary mode (perhead vs perlayer). both can cause repeated content once kvcache wraps.

anya: ran a quick token-id mapping check 16: shows a +1 offset for tail tokens >50000. not sure why only the tail.

ram: that could be an export sentinel adjustment issue. also qpack v1 can interleave heads differently; try rebuilding with qpack=v2 that preserves natural head order.

ci-bot: build pipeline helios14b-int4 finished (sha: d4f2c) :white_check_mark:

anya: toggled runtime to REDWOOD_ROPE_MODE=perhead and reran  alignment improved but repeats still start post-wrap. adding `--dump-kv-idx=2000-2060` to bench to trace indices.

tess: add an artificial repeat test that forces multiple wraps (e.g., repeat a 1.2k token chunk 8x)  deterministic repro. also dump sin/cos per-head for a few layers to ensure rope mode consistent.

anya: doing rebuild with qpack=v2 + headwrap-fix branch, plus adding synthetic wrap test and nfkc normalization check on tokenizer. will run overnight longctx sweep and post logs.

ram: solid plan  if qpack v2 + headwrap-fix fixes it we should canary on a dedicated node and add a regression that runs the synthetic wrap test in CI.

anya: thanks  pinging @ram @tess for anything else.
